regime_classes.label: working
regime_classes.one_line_definition: A continuous six-primitive kernel regime with persistent variation, rotating lens/packaging competition, and active tau/budget feedback.
regime_classes.evidence_support: All 12 sweep runs fell in the exploratory lawful regime class.

regime_classes.label: stretch
regime_classes.one_line_definition: A broader continuous six-primitive kernel regime obtained by widening the admissible parameter shell around the observed exploratory regime.
regime_classes.evidence_support: The sweep suggests the same full-loop mechanism may persist beyond the current small neighborhood.

candidate_assumptions.note: Observed mean variation stayed around 0.17-0.20 across the sweep.
Lens competition rotated among three lenses in the pilot and sweep.
Packaging competition rotated among three packagings in the pilot and sweep.
Tau adapted in the pilot and remained active throughout the sweep.
Budget range and volatility were large enough to modulate action selection.

candidate_assumptions.threshold: all six knockouts materially degrade the loop
candidate_assumptions.note: The knockout audit reports material degradation for every removed primitive.

candidate_assumptions.threshold: switch rates remain bounded away from both 0 and 1
candidate_assumptions.note: Lens and packaging switch rates stayed around one quarter of the trajectory length.

candidate_assumptions.threshold: no near_frozen or collapsed runs in the sweep window
candidate_assumptions.note: All 12 sweep runs were classified as lawful_exploratory.

P1.note: P1 knockout materially degrades the loop and suppresses tau switching.

P2.note: P2 knockout materially degrades the loop and changes the stability regime.

P3.note: P3 knockout collapses lens/packaging switching and weakens the adaptive loop.

P5.note: P5 knockout kills packaging switching and weakens the loop materially.

notes: The regime evidence is extracted from the continuous-kernel sweep and knockout audit.
The theorem assumptions should be stated separately from the observed regime labels.
